differential.name: Insulin excess due to reduced renal clearance in advanced CKD
differential.rationale: Impaired insulin degradation in stage 4 CKD commonly causes fasting hypoglycemia, especially in diabetics on insulin.

differential.name: Sulfonylurea‑induced hypoglycemia
differential.rationale: Oral hypoglycemics accumulate in renal failure, raising risk of low blood glucose in elderly patients.

differential.name: Primary adrenal insufficiency (Addison disease)
differential.rationale: Can present with fasting hypoglycemia, fatigue, and low‑grade pain; more likely in patients with chronic illness and stress.

differential.name: Sepsis‑related hypoglycemia
differential.rationale: Systemic infection can precipitate low glucose in frail, dialysis‑dependent elders, often with subtle pain or malaise.

differential.name: Malnutrition‑related hypoglycemia
differential.rationale: Chronic protein‑energy wasting in CKD and dialysis patients can lower glycogen stores and cause fasting glucose drops.
